data.name: Cleaving Line
data.description: Shared pool record A1. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws their ninjato in one flat stroke, and a thin blade of chakra peels from the edge and races down the line toward %target. Anything standing in its path is cut clean through the guard.

data.name: Shattering Ring
data.description: Shared pool record A2. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps down hard and drives chakra through the soles of their sandals. A ring of force cracks outward across the ground, splintering stone and fence posts as it rolls over %target and anyone near them.

data.name: Erupting Ground
data.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

data.name: Cataclysm Fist
data.description: Shared pool record B01. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers chakra into one clenched fist until the air around it hums. They cross the distance in a single step and drive the blow into %target with the weight of a falling temple beam.

data.name: Annihilating Wave
data.description: Shared pool record B02. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user sweeps both arms wide and releases a crushing wall of chakra across the field. It tears loose roof tiles and flattens the grass as it breaks over %target and everyone beside them.

data.name: Sovereign Undertow
data.description: Shared pool record B03. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user plunges a hand into the earth and twists, turning the ground beneath %target into a dragging current of chakra. Before they can brace, %target is hauled across the battlefield like driftwood in a flood.

data.name: Choking Seal
data.description: Shared pool record B04. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user brushes a binding sigil onto a paper seal in a single stroke and flings it at %target. The ink sinks into their chakra network and chokes its flow, so every technique they cast for a time lands weaker.

data.name: Devouring Grasp
data.description: Shared pool record B05. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes out with a coiling hand of chakra that seizes %target by the collar. It strikes hard and does not let go, feeding on their chakra and stamina in the moments that follow.

data.name: Split Image
data.description: Shared pool record B06. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves the Ram seal and presses chakra into the earth at their side. A second %user rises from it, identical down to the dust on their tabi, and steps into the fight.

data.name: Stolen Form
data.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

data.name: Dragging Hour
data.description: Shared pool record B08. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user sounds a low chime of chakra that settles over %target like river fog. Every motion %target makes begins to drag, and each technique costs them more effort to complete.

data.name: Veilstep
data.description: Shared pool record B09. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user lets their breathing fall silent and slips behind a veil of chakra. Their outline thins like smoke from a snuffed lantern until nothing is left to strike.

data.name: Sovereign Ascendance
data.description: Shared pool record B10. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Tiger seal and floods every chakra point in their body at once. Their strikes grow heavier and their stance turns to iron, the bearing of a warlord who has no intention of falling.

data.name: Sovereign Malediction
data.description: Shared pool record B11. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user presses a burning curse mark onto %target, and black script crawls across their skin. The brand seals away their bloodline, leaves them open to every blow, and keeps searing as further hits land.

data.name: Sovereign Ruin
data.description: Shared pool record B12. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user traces a slow spiral of dark chakra and casts it over %target like a funeral shroud. Their strikes lose their bite, and their wounds refuse to close.

data.name: Cursed Thread Weave
data.description: Shared pool record B13. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks out threads of hostile chakra that lash around %target and bite into their skin. The weave saps their strength, slows their recovery, and leaves them easier to wound.

data.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
data.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

data.name: Feast of Marrow
data.description: Shared pool record B15. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user drives their palm into the ground, and jagged spines of chakra erupt beneath %target. Each spine that pierces them drinks deeply, draining their chakra and stamina away.

data.name: Sovereign Fetters
data.description: Shared pool record B16. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls chains of chakra that wrap %target from shoulder to ankle and crush tight. The bindings leave them stunned and seal away their bloodline while the links hold.

data.name: Great Bell Toll
data.description: Shared pool record B17. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together, and chakra rings out like a struck temple bell. The shockwave rolls over %target and everyone around them, leaving them reeling and unable to act.

data.name: Oni's Hunger
data.description: Shared pool record B18. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user lets a ravenous surge of chakra loose through their body, and their eyes take on a feral glint. The hunger does not fade, feeding every blow and every movement for the rest of the fight.

data.name: Warrior's Poise
data.description: Shared pool record B19. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and settles their breathing, drawing chakra evenly through every limb. Their strikes come sharper and their guard stands firmer, the poise of a seasoned swordsman.

data.name: Surging Overflow
data.description: Shared pool record B20. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user opens the gates of their chakra and lets it flow freely through their body. Power floods their limbs, sharpening their strikes and strengthening every movement.

data.name: Hushed Hours
data.description: Shared pool record B21. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user slows their breathing to the stillness of the hour before dawn and gathers chakra close around them. Blows that land are drawn in and turned into vitality while their next attacks gain an edge.

data.name: Folding Screen Guard
data.description: Shared pool record B22. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user folds chakra into overlapping panels like a byobu screen and draws them close around their body. Incoming blows are softened, and part of their force is drawn back in as vitality.

data.name: Bulwark Charge
data.description: Shared pool record B23. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user crosses their arms and hardens a shell of chakra around themselves, bracing like a castle gate. Behind it they gather force for a heavier counterattack.

data.name: Veilstrike
data.description: Shared pool record B24. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user slips into shadow beneath a veil of chakra, tending their wounds as they vanish. When they move again, their blows will land harder and the strikes against them softer.

data.name: Braced Strike
data.description: Shared pool record B26. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a guarded blow into %target, keeping their stance low and their elbows tight. Chakra hardens along their arms to blunt whatever answer comes back.

data.name: Scorching Rend
data.description: Shared pool record B27. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user rakes a burning edge of chakra across %target, leaving a wound that smolders like charcoal. The cut keeps bleeding, and every blow that follows sears it hotter.

data.name: Backlash Palm
data.description: Shared pool record B28. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a chakra-charged palm into %target, infusing them with unstable energy that lashes back whenever they deal damage. The mark pulses beneath their skin, waiting for them to strike.

data.name: Devouring Wave
data.description: Shared pool record B29. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a hungry wave of chakra through %target and pulls part of its force back into their own body. For a time, the blows that land on %user are drawn in and turned into vitality.

data.name: Suppressing Roar
data.description: Shared pool record B30. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws a deep breath and releases a roar laced with chakra that shakes paper from the shoji. %target and everyone beside them are staggered, their attacks weakened by the force of it.

data.name: Rallying Spiral
data.description: Shared pool record B31. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user spins a widening spiral of chakra over %target and the allies around them. While it turns, their guard steadies and their strikes sharpen.

data.name: Dispelling Wave
data.description: Shared pool record B32. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Ram seal and releases a cold pulse of chakra across the field. Every enhancement wrapped around %target and those beside them is stripped away in an instant.

data.name: Piercing Judgment
data.description: Shared pool record B33. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user condenses lightning into a slender needle of chakra and drives it straight through %target's defenses. The puncture leaves them exposed to the next assault.

data.name: Mirror Edge
data.description: Shared pool record B34. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user cuts across %target with a blade of chakra polished bright as a mirror. The edge keeps its shine afterward, ready to turn part of any returning blow back on its sender.

data.name: Reaping Strike
data.description: Shared pool record B35. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user swings through %target in a reaping arc and draws the spent chakra back along the blade. The stolen strength closes some of their own wounds.

data.name: Withering Weave
data.description: Shared pool record B36. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user threads a wasting current of chakra through %target like a needle through silk. The weave wounds them, softens their defenses, and slows their recovery.

data.name: Fighter's Poise
data.description: Shared pool record B37. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user settles into a compact stance, knees bent and weight centered, wasting no motion. Their strikes grow sharper and their guard steadier for a short time.

data.name: Minor Overflow
data.description: Shared pool record B38. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user coaxes a small surplus of chakra into their muscles. For a few moments their strikes carry more weight and their movements come quicker.

data.name: Light Barrier
data.description: Shared pool record B39. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user raises a translucent shell of chakra around themselves, thin as rice paper but tightly woven. It catches the blows meant for them until it breaks.

data.name: Gale Bolt
data.description: Shared pool record EA01. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws a breath, shapes wind chakra into a spearpoint between two fingers, and fires it at %target. The gust strikes with a sharp crack, like a kite string snapping taut.

data.name: Tempest Breaker
data.description: Shared pool record EA02. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user whips a violent gust of wind chakra into %target at close range. The blast strikes hard and hurls them back across the battlefield.

data.name: Windlash Focus
data.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

data.name: Wind Spear
data.description: Shared pool record EA04. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses the air into a narrow spear of wind chakra and drives it straight through %target. The point punches past their guard as if it were not there.

data.name: Shale Bolt
data.description: Shared pool record EE01. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user pulls splinters of slate from the ground with a twist of chakra and packs them into a single stone. They hurl it at %target with a sharp flick of the wrist.

data.name: Bedrock Breaker
data.description: Shared pool record EE02. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user slams both palms down, and the ground beneath %target splits and buckles. Stone surges up around their legs, staggering them and pinning their feet in place.

data.name: Stoneward
data.description: Shared pool record EE03. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user sets their feet and draws a crust of earth chakra across their skin like fired clay. Blows that land on them lose much of their force.

data.name: Cinder Bolt
data.description: Shared pool record EF01. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a single cinder of fire chakra and flicks it toward %target. It burns white-hot as it flies and bursts against them in a spray of sparks.

data.name: Pyre Breaker
data.description: Shared pool record EF02. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user splits the ground beneath %target with a burning seam of fire chakra. Flame bursts up through the crack and leaves a scorched wound that keeps eating at them.

data.name: Emberwake
data.description: Shared pool record EF03. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user sweeps a rolling wake of embers over %target. The heat settles into their clothes and skin, so every blow that follows burns hotter.

data.name: Lightning Needle
data.description: Shared pool record EL01. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws crackling lightning chakra to a fingertip and releases it in a single bright arc. It snaps across the distance and strikes %target with a burst of white light.

data.name: Thunderclap Breaker
data.description: Shared pool record EL02. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a fist wrapped in lightning chakra into %target, and thunder cracks on impact. The charge lingers along their own skin, ready to throw part of any returning blow back on its sender.

data.name: Numbing Spark
data.description: Shared pool record EL03. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps a quick spark of lightning chakra into %target. The jolt locks their muscles and stops them in their tracks for a moment.

data.name: Raijin's Spear
data.description: Shared pool record EL04. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user shapes a concentrated spear of lightning chakra that hisses and spits in their grip. They drive it cleanly through %target, the point piercing every defense in its way.

data.name: Tide Bolt
data.description: Shared pool record EW01. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws water from the air into a dense bead of chakra between their fingers. They flick it at %target, and it strikes with the force of a hurled stone.

data.name: Deluge Breaker
data.description: Shared pool record EW02. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user calls up a surge of water chakra and crashes it into %target at close range. As the wave recedes, it wraps around %user in a protective layer of water.

data.name: Springguard
data.description: Shared pool record EW03. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers a cool spring of chakra around themselves, like water rising in a well. Blows that strike them are drawn in and turned into vitality.

data.name: Heavy Strike
data.description: A committed, full-weight blow.
data.battleDescription: %user plants their feet, twists from the hips, and puts their whole weight behind one heavy strike. It lands on %target with a crack that echoes across the field.

data.name: Quick Strike
data.description: A fast, reliable attack.
data.battleDescription: %user darts in with a compact strike, quick as a swallow, aimed at an opening in %target's guard. The welt it leaves flares hot under every blow that follows, and the rush of the hit sharpens %user's own attacks.

data.name: Lunging Strike
data.description: An attack with reach behind it.
data.battleDescription: %user springs across the gap with a burst of chakra in their legs and thrusts a driving attack into %target. The lunge closes the distance in a single heartbeat.

data.name: Opening Strike
data.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
data.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

data.name: Twin Kunai
data.description: Two quick projectiles in succession.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

data.name: Shuriken Storm
data.description: A stream of light projectiles.
data.battleDescription: %user fans a handful of shuriken between their fingers and loosens them in rapid succession. They whistle past %target's guard from every angle and leave deep cuts that keep bleeding.

data.name: Numbing Senbon
data.description: A shot that briefly staggers.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a senbon needle, its tip glinting, into a nerve point on %target. The strike can lock their muscles for a moment and leave them staggered.

data.name: Weakening Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S27. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user lands a precise blow on %target's sword arm, numbing it to the shoulder. Their attacks lose their force for a short time.

data.name: Enervating Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S28. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes a chakra point on %target with two stiff fingers. Strength drains from their limbs, leaving every technique weaker until it recovers.

data.name: Venom Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S29. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

data.name: Searing Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S30. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes %target with a hand wreathed in heat, leaving embers smoldering in the folds of their clothing. Every blow that follows burns hotter.

data.name: Unraveling Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

data.name: Lingering Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S32. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes %target with chakra that clings to the wound like pine sap. Until it fades, nothing can cleanse the harm laid on them.

data.name: Marking Volley
data.description: Shared pool record S33. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user sends a sweeping volley of kunai across the field, and chakra marks bloom wherever they strike. %target and everyone beside them are left exposed to the attacks that follow.

data.name: Purging Stance
data.description: Shared pool record S34. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Snake seal, steadies their breathing, and pushes chakra outward through every pore. Poisons, curses and lingering harm are flushed from their body.

data.name: Second Wind
data.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

data.name: Warding Stance
data.description: Shared pool record S36. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user takes a disciplined guard and wraps themselves in a tight weave of chakra. For a time, curses and weakening techniques slide off them like rain off oiled paper.

data.name: Glancing Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S38. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a swift strike across %target, more feint than blow. It tests their defenses and searches for an opening.

data.name: Bruising Blow
data.description: Shared pool record S39. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a short, solid blow into %target's side. It lands with a dull thud that rattles their guard.

data.name: Measured Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S40. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user measures the distance to %target with a calm eye and delivers a clean, controlled strike. Nothing in the motion is wasted.

data.name: Steady Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S41. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user holds their footing and lands a steady, deliberate blow on %target. It is the patient strike of a fighter who has drilled it ten thousand times.

data.name: Forceful Strike
data.description: Shared pool record S42. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their full weight into a forceful strike against %target. The impact knocks the breath from them.

data.name: Heavy Cut
data.description: Shared pool record S43. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user draws a heavy cutting arc through %target's defenses, putting their shoulders into the swing. The blade bites deep.

data.name: Sundering Blow
data.description: Shared pool record S44. Balance values pending sign-off.
data.battleDescription: %user brings a sundering blow down on %target with chakra packed behind it. The strike lands with enough force to split a wooden gate.
